science_vegetable: Magnetohydrodynamic Kelvin-Helmholtz shear across the ferrofluid sea

horizon_goals.immediate_session_goal: Understand the sheer mechanics to stabilize the raft.
horizon_goals.campaign_arc_climax: Solve the mystery of the planet's magnetic core.

active_location.macro_silhouette: The cramped interior of the submersible raft shakes violently with every magnetic shift. The rusted iron walls hum with latent energy, casting a dull, flickering orange glow across the scattered diagnostic equipment.

sensory_palette.sight_and_color: Flickering orange glow, rusted iron walls.

interactive_features.affordance_description: Can be rewired to absorb the magnetic shock.
Vents steam to hide the raft's heat signature.
Draws the surrounding ferrofluid to stabilize the craft.

reactive_toys.immediate_complication: The pulse threatens to tear apart the raft's hull.
reactive_toys.uninterrupted_escalation: The hull will breach, flooding the interior with deadly ferrofluid.

three_levels_of_why.level_2_local: To safely navigate the ferrofluid sea.
three_levels_of_why.level_3_campaign_arc: To unlock the secrets of the planet's magnetic anomalies.
